wf(task): submit task-003-make-applypatch-conform-to-rfc-6902-in-every-case

Carries content: the body

WingFoil-Version: 0.3.1 (unknown)

Make applyPatch reject non-JSON values and inherited operation members

- Reject a value (or a document) that is not JSON: undefined, functions, symbols,
  bigints, non-finite numbers, class instances such as Date, and circular values.
  A copy would otherwise silently turn them into a different, non-JSON result.
- Read an operation's op, path, from and value as own members only, and require
  the operation to be a plain object.
- Report a patch with holes as an invalid patch, not as a TypeError.
- Cover each case with tests, and document the rules in the README.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
